an9.19:1.1: 19 imañca bhikkhave rattiṃ sambahulā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho bhikkhave tā maṃ etadavocuṃ
an9.19:1.2: upasaṅkamiṃsu no bhante pubbe manussabhūtānaṃ pabbajitā agārāni
an9.19:1.3: te mayaṃ bhante paccuṭṭhimha no ca kho abhivādimha
an9.19:1.4: te mayaṃ bhante aparipuṇṇakammantā vippaṭisāriniyo pacchānutāpiniyo hīnaṃ kāyaṃ upapannāti.
an9.19:2.1: aparāpi maṃ bhikkhave sambahulā devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ
an9.19:2.2: upasaṅkamiṃsu no bhante pubbe manussabhūtānaṃ pabbajitā agārāni
an9.19:2.3: te mayaṃ bhante paccuṭṭhimha ca abhivādimha ca no ca kho āsanaṃ adimha
an9.19:2.4: te mayaṃ bhante aparipuṇṇakammantā vippaṭisāriniyo pacchānutāpiniyo hīnaṃ kāyaṃ upapannāti.
an9.19:3.1: aparāpi maṃ bhikkhave sambahulā devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ
an9.19:3.2: upasaṅkamiṃsu no bhante pubbe manussabhūtānaṃ pabbajitā agārāni
an9.19:3.3: te mayaṃ bhante paccuṭṭhimha ca abhivādimha ca āsanañca adimha no ca kho yathāsatti yathābalaṃ saṃvibhajimha …pe…
an9.19:3.4: yathāsatti yathābalaṃ saṃvibhajimha no ca kho upanisīdimha dhammassavanāya
an9.19:3.5: upanisīdimha dhammassavanāya no ca kho ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇimha
an9.19:3.6: ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇimha no ca kho sutvā dhammaṃ dhārayimha
an9.19:3.7: sutvā ca dhammaṃ dhārayimha no ca kho dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhimha
an9.19:3.8: dhatānañca dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhimha no ca kho atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipajjimha te
an9.19:3.9: mayaṃ bhante aparipuṇṇakammantā vippaṭisāriniyo pacchānutāpiniyo hīnaṃ kāyaṃ upapannāti.
an9.19:4.1: aparāpi maṃ bhikkhave sambahulā devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ
an9.19:4.2: upasaṅkamiṃsu no bhante pubbe manussabhūtānaṃ pabbajitā agārāni
an9.19:4.3: te mayaṃ bhante paccuṭṭhimha ca abhivādimha ca āsanañca adimha yathāsatti yathābalaṃ saṃvibhajimha upanisīdimha ca dhammassavanāya ohitasotā ca dhammaṃ suṇimha sutvā dhammaṃ dhārayimha dhatānañca dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhimha atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipajjimha te
an9.19:4.4: mayaṃ bhante paripuṇṇakammantā avippaṭisāriniyo apacchānutāpiniyo paṇītaṃ kāyaṃ upapannāti.
an9.19:4.5: etāni bhikkhave rukkhamūlāni etāni suññāgārāni jhāyatha bhikkhave mā pamādatha mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha seyyathāpi tā purimikā devatāti.
